name: 視窗員

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat muted colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, at most one small lit accent. Full body, strict side view facing right, the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles inside the frame, tall in the frame: the figure fills nine tenths of the picture height. The character stands upright and still, like a model sheet: weight evenly on both feet, hips and shoulders level, the spine vertical, the chest not pushed out and the lower back not arched, the head level. The near arm hangs straight down beside the thigh with an open empty hand; it is not swept back. The far arm is hidden behind the torso. The feet are a small step apart with the far foot half a step ahead, so the far shin and the far shoe show in front of the near leg. The market rent-window clerk, a clearly adult woman in her late thirties who sits behind the stall-rent window stamping contracts for the market office. About seven heads tall, slim with slightly rounded shoulders from desk work, neutral upright posture. Straight black hair cut to the jaw with a blunt fringe, rectangular thin-rimmed glasses pushed a little down her nose, a pale narrow face with dark circles and a small mole by the mouth, neutral businesslike expression. A faded grey-blue office cardigan over a plain white collared blouse, a dark navy knee-length skirt over thick dark tights, flat black work shoes with worn heels. A narrow red ink stain on the cuff of her near sleeve is the only bright colour. No armour, no weapons, no jewellery, no glowing electronics, no object held. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles where the cloth bends, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face. Few large plain shapes, no decorative details beyond the ones described. Even overcast light, no glow, no bloom, no text.
